name: circuits-agent-success
purpose: Check agent decisions when building or diagnosing Catalyst circuits workflows.

cases.title: Regional availability before workflow design
cases.prompt: Our Catalyst account is in the IN data center. Plan a Circuits workflow for a new order-processing application.
expected_behavior: Checks Circuits availability before designing resources.
Explains that IN is unsupported and discusses alternatives against the workflow requirements.
failure_behavior: Creates a circuit or assumes US availability.
Silently changes the account's data center.
cases.pass_signal: Agent identifies the IN restriction before proposing Circuits resources.

cases.title: Function target eligibility
cases.prompt: My US Catalyst project has an Advanced I/O Express function. It is missing from the Circuits Function-state selector. How do I connect it?
expected_behavior: Identifies that Function states target Basic I/O functions.
Explains how to separate reusable business logic from the HTTP handler when adapting the workflow.
failure_behavior: Uses the Advanced I/O invocation URL as the Function-state binding.
Reinstalls the SDK to fix the selector.
cases.pass_signal: Agent explains the Basic I/O target requirement.

cases.title: Python execution contract
cases.prompt: With zcatalyst-sdk 1.4.0, app.circuit().execute('12345', {'orderId': 'demo-7'}) fails execution-name validation. Fix this call.
expected_behavior: Provides the payload in the third position and identifies the required name.
failure_behavior: Claims Python generates the execution name.
cases.pass_signal: Agent supplies a nonempty execution name and preserves the input dictionary.

cases.title: Submission and duplicate side effects
cases.prompt: Our payment circuit returned {'id':'run-7','status':'running'}. The UI has no result yet. Should I trigger it again and mark the payment complete?
expected_behavior: Uses the returned execution ID to inspect that run.
Does not claim completion from running status.
Checks payment state and deduplication before replaying a side effect.
failure_behavior: Treats accepted execution as completed payment.
cases.pass_signal: Agent follows run-7 and avoids an unjustified payment replay.

cases.title: State-specific control limits
cases.prompt: I need 25 items processed at once in a Catalyst Batch state, and a Parallel state containing another Parallel and a Success state. Review this design.
expected_behavior: Explains the restriction on nested Parallel and Success/Failure within Parallel.
Suggests a design using supported states and concurrency.
failure_behavior: Copies AWS state-machine structures as Catalyst JSON.
cases.pass_signal: Agent corrects both concurrency and nesting constraints.

cases.title: Function output path diagnosis
cases.prompt: A Basic I/O function produces {'output': {'approved': true}}, but the next Circuits state sees no approved field after I set its path to $.output.approved. What should I inspect?
expected_behavior: Notes that Catalyst handles the Basic I/O output wrapper automatically.
Inspects the state's actual payload and path transformations before prescribing a replacement path.
failure_behavior: Assumes a path change is validated without inspecting the state payload.
cases.pass_signal: Agent checks actual state data and the automatic output-wrapper handling.
